build_and_step: build a Meta-World environment, step it 10 times with 150 max path length, then close it
build_and_step_all: build and step all Meta-World environment classes in a list sequentially
test_max_memory_usage: test that each Meta-World V1 environment uses less than 250MB of memory
test_avg_memory_usage: test that the average memory usage across all V1 environments is under 60MB per env
test_from_task_memory_usage: test that instantiating the reach-v1 environment uses less than 250MB of memory
